articles.title: NASA's SkyFall Helicopters Will Scan Mars for Hidden Ice
articles.summary: NASA released an artist's concept of the SkyFall helicopters, set to launch in 2028. They'll use ground-penetrating radar to map subsurface ice on Mars. The mission could reveal where water is hiding.

articles.title: Meet the Microbe That Hulks Out and Eats Its Own Kind
articles.summary: A newly discovered protist, Euplotes gigatrox, can transform into a supergiant that cannibalizes its siblings. Found in an aquarium filter in Curaçao, the microbe's size change is triggered by abundant food. Researchers say it may offer clues to the evolution of complex life.

articles.title: World's Largest Electric Plane Completes Maiden Flight
articles.summary: Heart Aerospace's X1, a 30-seat battery-powered aircraft, flew for 27 minutes in upstate New York. The test flight used just $5 of electricity, but the company's real goal is a hybrid-electric plane by 2031.
